description.en: These frames show the hallway extending to the left, with a framed plant picture visible on the left wall; a large wooden storage unit/wardrobe with a grey coat is on the right; an open doorway is ahead, and the view remains within the hallway.

description.zh: 这些帧的视角主要贴近右侧灰色外套，走廊大部分被遮挡；只能确认相机朝右侧储物柜方向观察，不能据此认定为转入新通路。
description.en: These frames are mostly close to the grey coat on the right, with most of the hallway obscured; they only confirm that the camera looked toward the storage unit on the right and do not establish a turn into a new passage.

semantic_progress.zh: 已向右转离开黑金画边桌并进入走廊；截至B仍位于右侧挂灰色外套的木质储物柜旁，左侧墙面可见植物框画，前方敞开门洞尚未通过。尚未确认经过右侧浴室门口，也未左转进入卧室，电视、梳妆台、床及窗前停止点均未到达。
semantic_progress.en: The robot has turned right away from the console table with the black and gold painting and entered the hallway; as of B it is still beside the wooden storage unit with the grey coat on the right, with a framed plant picture visible on the left wall, and it has not yet passed the open doorway ahead. It has not confirmed passing the bathroom doorway on the right, has not turned left into the bedroom, and has not reached the TV, dresser, bed, or the stopping point in front of the window.

uncertainties.zh: 中间帧多为右侧外套近景，无法确认A到B之间是否发生小幅前移。
uncertainties.en: Most intermediate frames are close-ups of the coat on the right, so it cannot be confirmed whether there was slight forward movement from A to B.

uncertainties.zh: 前方敞开门洞是否对应任务中的浴室门洞或卧室入口，单凭这些视角尚不能确定。
uncertainties.en: Whether the open doorway ahead corresponds to the bathroom doorway or the bedroom entrance in the task cannot be determined from these views alone.

segment_summary.zh: 从A到B，视角一度转向右侧储物柜上悬挂的灰色外套并靠近停留，随后回到走廊朝向；走廊左侧仍可见植物框画，右侧为木质储物柜，前方为敞开门洞。未观察到越过右侧浴室门洞、左转进入卧室或到达窗前。
segment_summary.en: From A to B, the view turned toward and moved closer to the grey coat hanging on the storage unit on the right, briefly lingered there, and then returned to face the hallway; the framed plant picture remains visible on the left, the wooden storage unit is on the right, and an open doorway is ahead. No crossing of the bathroom doorway on the right, left turn into the bedroom, or arrival at the window was observed.

reason.zh: 画面显示仍在走廊起始段、右侧衣柜旁，左侧植物画与前方敞开门洞的空间关系符合前段；未见穿入其他房间或反向通行，因此不构成偏航。但任务要求的“经过右侧浴室门洞后左转进入卧室”尚未发生，仍是进行中的直行要求。
reason.en: The frames show that the robot is still at the beginning of the hallway beside the wardrobe on the right; the spatial relation of the plant picture on the left and the open doorway ahead is consistent with the prior segment. No entry into another room or travel in the opposite direction is seen, so this is not a deviation. However, the required passing of the bathroom doorway on the right and then turning left into the bedroom has not yet occurred, and the straight-ahead requirement remains in progress.
